      "evidence": "Drops Boost.Test from CMake (AddBoostIfNeeded.cmake), depends (boost.mk), vcpkg, and Guix build scripts (build_linux.sh).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes the Boost.Test dependency across build systems and eliminates Guix stack workarounds. As noted in the description, the PR drops Boost test compile flags and Guix workarounds without affecting external release dependencies."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp only via a mechanical scripted-diff to update test macros.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical test header and macro updates that follow from test runner changes do not make a PR part of IPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp purely via a mechanical scripted-diff to use the new runner.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical test adjustments following a framework migration do not change kernel API or functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements an in-tree test framework in src/test/util/framework.h (+1209 lines) and transitions the entire unit test suite away from Boost.Test.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework that provides expression decomposition and enables custom runner customization. Josibake notes this allows customizing test runner behavior to Core's needs, unblocking concurrency improvements and removing barriers to writing tests."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The only contrib path touched is contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh, which is part of the build system.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Guix build scripts belong to the build category rather than tools."
    },
    {
